rounds.q: Of Americans who eat at sit-down restaurants, what % always tip?
rounds.why: But 57% say they'd tip 15% or less for an average meal.
rounds.src: Pew Research Center, Tipping culture in America (2023)
rounds.fun: Most diners always leave a tip, so thank you, kind strangers!

rounds.q: Of Americans who buy drinks at coffee shops, what % usually tip?
rounds.why: At fast casual restaurants, only 12% always or often leave a tip.
rounds.src: Pew Research Center, Tipping culture in America (2023)
rounds.fun: Only a quarter tip on coffee, so the tip jar is still waiting.

rounds.q: What % of US adults (20+) eat fast food on any given day?
rounds.why: Fast food makes up about 12% of the calories US adults eat in a day.
rounds.fun: About one in three adults eats fast food on a given day. Pass the napkins!

rounds.q: What % of US adults drank coffee in the past day?
rounds.why: More US adults drink coffee each day than any other drink, even water.
rounds.src: National Coffee Association, National Coffee Data Trends (2026)
rounds.fun: Two out of three adults had coffee in the past day. The mug club is huge.

rounds.q: What % of US adults drink alcohol, even just sometimes?
rounds.why: Among drinkers, beer leads at 36%, just ahead of liquor (32%) and wine (30%).
rounds.fun: Just over half of adults drink at all, so lots of people say no thanks.
